Salines de Djibouti et de Ma…

The 56 firms of highest weighted degree, ranged along the axis by territory and then by degree. Each arc is a tie resting on at least 2 shared directors — 321 of the 623 ties among these firms; at one shared director

the upper half of the figure becomes a solid wash. 230 of those 321 arcs (72%) cross a border: this is figure 24 seen firm by firm. An arc diagram gives up the two-dimensional layout to keep a readable ordering; here
the ordering is the variable, so that is the right trade.
